messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency exceeded for customer 'ZenCore Systems' in eu-west-2 (EU2). Metric p99=3.10s (SLO=1.00s). Page: oncall-mary. Incident ID: INC-1763456789. Link: https://metrics/redwood/INC-1763456789
oncall-mary: ack — joining warroom now.
sre-james: ack. I'll shadow and pull relevant queries for the zencoresys-eu2 serving cluster.
eng-runtime-lee: noticed increased tail latency on model v2.4.0 canary; KV cache hit rate dropped.
pm-ella: cc: @solutions-nina — I've pinged customer success, zencore ops is standing by. Any customer-visible errors?
cust-ops-zencore: we're seeing timeouts and 502 spikes from our app. traffic rate steady, errors started ~12:42 UTC.
solutions-nina: collecting request IDs from customer, will DM.
oncall-mary: quick triage: p95=1.2s p99=3.1s error rate 4.3% (baseline 0.8%). No full outage detected.
infra-ops-anjali: checking dedicated pool utilization and node health now.
infra-ops-anjali: ```gcloud compute ssh pool-eu2-monitor --command "top -b -n1 | head -n 20"``` (no node OOMs, CPU 65-92%)
sre-james: metrics query (prom): ```sum(rate(latency_seconds_bucket{customer="zencore"}[1m])) by (le)``` pulling histograms now.
eng-runtime-lee: KV cache hit rate for v2.4.0 dropped 98% -> 74% after rollout; looks like cache invalidation storm on start.
oncall-mary: did we kick any rollouts or config changes to this dedicated pool in the last 15m?
eng-runtime-lee: yes — automated rollout v2.4.0 started at 1763456700; small quantization change + model param tweak. Can rollback.
pm-ella: customer asks for ETA and mitigation. they'd prefer minimal impact — can we fallback to v2.3.1 quickly?
oncall-mary: initiating rollback to v2.3.1 for zencoresys-eu2. @eng-runtime-lee please execute canary rollback and hold scale-up.
eng-runtime-lee: executing rollback now -> ```deploy rollback --customer zencore --pool eu2 --to v2.3.1 --strategy canary --concurrency 10%``` starting 12:47 UTC
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback started (task-id: rb-5642). Autoscaler notifications suppressed for pool eu2.
infra-ops-anjali: scaling events muted for zencoresys-eu2. monitoring CPU/mem and queue depth.
sre-james: enabling KV prefix warmup for hotspots — running warmup script on pool nodes: ```python tools/warm_kv.py --customer zencore --pool eu2 --keys-file hot_keys.txt``` 
cust-ops-zencore: we've paused background jobs and reduced non-essential traffic ~10% per request.
oncall-mary: rollback progress: p99 3.1s -> 1.9s after 30s -> 1.05s after 90s. continuing to watch.
pm-ella: updating exec and CS; will relay progress to customer and ask them to validate.
eng-runtime-lee: rollback complete — v2.3.1 serving 100% on zencoresys-eu2. metrics: p95 0.9s p99 0.98s error rate 0.9%.
cust-ops-zencore: confirming timeouts cleared on our side, logs look healthy. thank you :clap: 
oncall-mary: marking incident mitigated. next steps: RCA, improve rollout gating, add KV warmup as preflight, add rollback threshold automation.
pm-ella: scheduling postmortem with customer Tue 10:00 UTC. @solutions-nina please prepare customer-facing summary and timeline.
solutions-nina: drafted summary, will share in #customer-comms for review.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1763456789 => mitigated. Status: monitoring. Runbook: https://wiki/runbooks/zencore-high-latency
oncall-mary: reassigning follow-up to eng-runtime for RCA and action items. thanks all. :thumbsup:
